Saudi Offers Houthis $1 Billion in Iran-Brokered Deal as Missiles Batter the Kingdom | GRAVITAS
Can $1 billion buy peace? Saudi Arabia has reportedly offered $1 billion to Yemen's Houthis as part of an Iran-brokered deal to secure a ceasefire and halt attacks on the Saudi kingdom. Did this so-called arrangement work out? What is brewing behind the scenes?
